parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the data migration instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据迁移实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Valid values: **30**, **50**, and **100**. Default value: **30**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be an integer greater than **0** and must not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: **1**
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于**0**且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为**1**
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the data migration instance. You can call the **DescribeMigrationJobs** operation to query instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据迁移实例ID，可以通过调用**DescribeMigrationJobs**接口查询
parameters.name: migration_job_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query the details of schema migration. Valid values:

- **true**: yes.
- **false**: no.
> Default value: **false**
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询结构迁移详情，取值：

- **true**：是。
- **false**：否。
> 默认值为**false**
parameters.name: migration_mode_structure_initialization

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query the details of full data migration. Valid values:

- **true**: yes.
- **false**: no.
> Default value: **false**
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询全量数据迁移详情，取值：

- **true**：是。
- **false**：否。
> 默认值为**false**
parameters.name: migration_mode_data_initialization

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query the details of incremental data migration. Valid values:

- **true**: yes.
- **false**: no.
> Default value: **false**
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询增量数据迁移详情，取值：

- **true**：是。
- **false**：否。
> 默认值为**false**
parameters.name: migration_mode_data_synchronization

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The value of **ClientToken** can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be discontinued
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id
